value.rationale: The 2014 eDNA literature records a genuine target-detection versus PCR-inhibitor tradeoff. The exact all-rate channel-shape classification plus closed-form two-channel global bifurcation and square-root transition constitutes a motivated complete optimal-design benchmark not implied by the empirical motivation, and the explicit deterioration under compulsory excess processing clarifies an important model boundary. Unlike generic classroom convexity deductions, the parameter-dependent nonconcave objective is globally classified with strict claims. It is a theoretical benchmark only.
